name: AutomationDirect KN-10J10 terminal jumper
summary: KN-10J10 terminal jumper arrangement: mounting, interface and service-space coordination.
description: KN-10J10 is the drawing identifier for terminal jumper in AutomationDirect's Konnect-It DIN-Rail Terminal Blocks collection. A terminal jumper makes a selected common connection between compatible terminal positions. Its mechanical reach and the positions connected must be checked against the actual terminal system.

For example, in a control-power terminal strip with a documented common distribution group, use the KN-10J10 reference to coordinate jumper installation space, terminal positions and identification. Show the neighbouring equipment and the connection route so the installer can understand the intended arrangement.

Use the reviewed native drawing identified as Other PLC Products/Konnect-It/KN-10J10.DWG for the exact physical details. Locate the named file in its original manufacturer archive. Manufacturer drawing previews are shown only when an exact approved source is available. Any illustrative 3D view is a separate concept and is not to scale; use the selected manufacturer documents for dimensions, ratings and installation details.
readingNotes: Keep jumper installation space, terminal positions and identification visible in the layout.
